target.definition: Total number of A&E attendances in England during September 2026, all A&E types, as reported in NHS England's monthly A&E Attendances and Emergency Admissions statistics.

provenance.rationale: ONS mid-2024 estimate ~57.0m, projected forward with modest growth.

inputs.name: annual_attendances_per_person
inputs.description: Annual A&E attendances per person in England.

provenance.rationale: NHS England reported ~26-27 million attendances per year recently; divided by population gives ~0.46.

inputs.name: september_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Fraction of annual A&E attendances occurring in September.

provenance.rationale: September has 30 days; monthly share is roughly 1/12, with slight seasonal variation.

inputs.name: daily_attendances_per_type1
inputs.description: Average daily A&E attendances at a major (type 1) A&E department.

provenance.rationale: Typical large hospital A&E sees a few hundred patients per day.

inputs.name: type1_departments
inputs.description: Number of major (type 1) A&E departments in England.

provenance.rationale: NHS England lists around 220 type 1 A&E departments.

inputs.name: other_ae_share
inputs.description: Share of total A&E attendances that are at non-type-1 facilities (type 2, 3, 4: minor injury units, walk-in centres, etc.).

provenance.rationale: NHS England data show roughly 15-25% of attendances are at non-type-1 facilities.

inputs.name: annual_gp_consultations_per_person
inputs.description: Annual GP consultations per person in England.

provenance.rationale: Commonly cited figure of about 5 GP consultations per person per year.

inputs.name: ae_to_gp_consultation_ratio
inputs.description: Ratio of A&E attendances to GP consultations.

provenance.rationale: A&E attendances are roughly 9% of GP consultations (26m vs 300m).

paths.description: Estimate annual attendances from population and per-capita rate, then allocate to September.
Count type 1 departments, multiply by daily attendances and days, then scale up for other A&E types.
Scale from annual GP consultations using the ratio of A&E attendances to GP consultations, then allocate to September.
